name: Trundle
tagline: Know where every truck is before your customer calls to ask.
positioning: Trundle turns raw GPS pings, engine faults, and driver drama into decisions your ops team actually makes — priced by the mile, not by the seat.

hero.h1: Your fleet is lying to you. We caught it on camera.
hero.sub: Trundle ingests telemetry from 40,000-vehicle fleets and tells you the one thing every dashboard hides: what's actually happening right now, and what it's about to cost you.

features.title: Faults, translated
features.description: OBD codes come in as gibberish. Trundle turns P0299 into 'turbo underboost on Unit 214, schedule it before Thursday' — with the part number attached.

features.title: Geofences that behave
features.description: Draw a yard, a customer site, a route corridor. Get pinged when a driver lingers, deviates, or takes the scenic route home with your reefer trailer.

features.title: Idle you can bill back
features.description: We tag every idle minute by cause, driver, and depot — so the fuel line item in your QBR stops being a mystery and starts being a lever.

features.title: One API, no forklift
features.description: Samsara, Geotab, Motive, whatever's already bolted to the dash. Trundle reads them all and normalizes to a single schema your BI team won't hate.

features.title: Alerts with restraint
features.description: Nobody reads 900 notifications. We rank by dollars at risk and route only the ones a human should touch to the human who owns that lane.

features.title: Audit-grade history
features.description: Every ping, every event, retained and immutable. When a claims adjuster or the DOT comes asking, the answer is a URL, not a three-day scramble.

testimonials.quote: We were paying three analysts to reconcile telematics exports every Monday. Trundle killed the spreadsheet. One of them now runs our route optimization instead, which is a much better use of a human.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor

testimonials.quote: The idle attribution alone paid for the contract in a quarter. Turns out one depot was leaving reefers running overnight 'to be safe.' It was safe. It was also $70k a year.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: I've bought four telematics platforms in my career. This is the first one where the sales demo matched what shipped. Suspicious at first. Delighted now.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramaswamy

pricing.blurb: For regional fleets who want signal, not another login to babysit.
Volume pricing for multi-depot operators. Pay for miles moved, not seats sold.
For 10,000+ vehicle enterprises with procurement teams that ask hard questions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Trundle — fleet telematics for people who've been burned by dashboards. Metered by the mile, honest by design.
